question.prompt: Chord \(AB\) of \(\odot O\) has length \(AB=24\). The distance from the center \(O\) to \(AB\) is \(5\). Find the radius of \(\odot O\).

solutions.explanation: The half-chord length is \(12\), and the distance from the center to the chord is \(5\). The radius is \(\sqrt{12^2+5^2}=13\).
solutions.title: Radius as the hypotenuse
